${modID}:ExampleCard.NAME: Name
${modID}:ExampleCard.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: This will automatically be used if the card is upgraded. Remove it if unneeded.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: You can put more text in here.
If you need to use it for stuff.
Blizzard is a good example for this.

${modID}:WaxBallSlide.NAME: Wax Ball Slide
${modID}:WaxBallSlide.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage, then slide right to each other enemy for !M! less each time.

${modID}:ProtectiveChant.NAME: Protective Chant
${modID}:ProtectiveChant.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL If you completed a ${modID}:Chant this turn, gain !M! more.

${modID}:BigFlammaFlex.NAME: Big Flamma Flex
${modID}:BigFlammaFlex.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! ${modID}:Heat. NL At the end of your turn, lose !M! ${modID}:Heat.

${modID}:Stoke.NAME: Stoke
${modID}:Stoke.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! ${modID}:Heat. NL If your ${modID}:Heat is below half of your Max HP, gain !M! more.

${modID}:VulnerabilityHex.NAME: Vulnerability Hex
${modID}:VulnerabilityHex.DESCRIPTION: ${modID}:Chant. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Apply !M! Vulnerable.

${modID}:FreeStrike.NAME: Free Strike
${modID}:FreeStrike.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:Scrying.NAME: Scrying
${modID}:Scrying.DESCRIPTION: Scry !M!. NL Draw 1 card. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:TutorTwo.NAME: Tutor Two
${modID}:TutorTwo.DESCRIPTION: Choose a card from your draw pile and add it to your hand. NL Upgrade it. It costs 0 this turn. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:InvokeGlart.NAME: Invoke Glart
${modID}:InvokeGlart.DESCRIPTION: Draw cards until your hand is full. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:Outburst.NAME: Outburst
${modID}:Outburst.DESCRIPTION: Play the top !M! cards of your draw pile. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:LetHimCook.NAME: Let Him Cook
${modID}:LetHimCook.DESCRIPTION: At the end of combat, if you ${modID}:Overheated this combat, heal !M! HP.

${modID}:DissonantVerse.NAME: Dissonant Verse
${modID}:DissonantVerse.DESCRIPTION: Lose all ${modID}:Chant progress. NL Deal !D! damage.

${modID}:SplashWax.NAME: Splash Wax
${modID}:SplashWax.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Exhaust a card in your hand. If it was a Burn, deal !M! additional damage. NL Lose 10 ${modID}:Heat.

${modID}:Vent.NAME: Vent
${modID}:Vent.DESCRIPTION: Lose half of your ${modID}:Heat. NL Deal damage equal to half the ${modID}:Heat lost.

${modID}:Inferno.NAME: Inferno
${modID}:Inferno.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Deals !M! additional damage for every 10 ${modID}:Heat you have.

${modID}:InvokeLightning.NAME: Invoke Lightning
${modID}:InvokeLightning.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy !M! times. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:Ipsum.NAME: Ipsum
${modID}:Ipsum.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Artifact. NL Gain !B! ${modID}:Melting_Block. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:ExpressiveIteration.NAME: Expressive Iteration
${modID}:ExpressiveIteration.DESCRIPTION: Look at the top 3 cards of your draw pile. NL Put one into your hand, Exhaust one, and leave one on top.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose a card to put into your hand.

${modID}:Extinguish.NAME: Extinguish
${modID}:Extinguish.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Gain !B! Block. NL Lose 20 ${modID}:Heat. NL Shuffle a Burn into your draw pile.

${modID}:LightTheCandle.NAME: Light the Candle
${modID}:LightTheCandle.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL If this is the third card played this turn, gain [E] .

${modID}:Stab.NAME: Stab
${modID}:Stab.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Add a Burn into your hand.

${modID}:WaxingMoon.NAME: Waxing Moon
${modID}:WaxingMoon.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Gain !B! Block. NL ${modID}:Chant 2 times.

${modID}:Wisps.NAME: Wisps
${modID}:Wisps.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Whenever you ${modID}:Overheat, put this into your hand.

${modID}:SacrificalLamb.NAME: Sacrificial Lamb
${modID}:SacrificalLamb.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If this kills a non-minion enemy, ${modID}:Chant 4 times.

${modID}:TheWaxMaster.NAME: The Wax Master
${modID}:TheWaxMaster.DESCRIPTION: Your Wax cards deal !M! additional damage and apply !M! more of their Wax effects.

${modID}:ChantMaxing.NAME: Chant Maxing
${modID}:ChantMaxing.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your turn, ${modID}:Chant.

${modID}:RecklessHeating.NAME: Reckless Heating
${modID}:RecklessHeating.DESCRIPTION: Gain 10 ${modID}:Heat for each Burn in your draw pile, hand and discard pile. NL Shuffle a Burn into your draw pile.

${modID}:HeatingUp.NAME: Heating Up
${modID}:HeatingUp.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card, gain !M! ${modID}:Heat.

${modID}:SelfPortrait.NAME: Self Portrait
${modID}:SelfPortrait.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your turn, add a ${modID}:Waxy copy of the first card you played last turn into your hand.

${modID}:CompleteDevotion.NAME: Complete Devotion
${modID}:CompleteDevotion.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust your hand. NL ${modID}:Chant once for each card Exhausted. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:ConsumeBurns.NAME: Consume Burns
${modID}:ConsumeBurns.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust ALL Burns in your draw pile, hand and discard pile. NL Gain !M! Strength for each.

${modID}:FinalLight.NAME: Final Light
${modID}:FinalLight.DESCRIPTION: For 3 turns, ${modID}:Overheat at the start of your turn and you cannot ${modID}:Burnout. NL Then, die. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:PriestForm.NAME: Priest Form
${modID}:PriestForm.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your turn, add a random ${modID}:Chant card into your hand.

${modID}:SnuffOut.NAME: Snuff Out
${modID}:SnuffOut.DESCRIPTION: If the enemy's HP is at or below your ${modID}:Heat, kill it. NL Set your ${modID}:Heat to 9. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:Kindling.NAME: Kindling
${modID}:Kindling.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, gain 10 ${modID}:Heat. NL If your ${modID}:Heat is at or above half of your Max HP, gain 4 Block instead.

${modID}:Preperations.NAME: Preparations
${modID}:Preperations.DESCRIPTION: ${modID}:Chant. NL Put a card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.

${modID}:Reshape.NAME: Reshape
${modID}:Reshape.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you draw a Burn, deal !M! damage to a random enemy.

${modID}:Unearth.NAME: Unearth
${modID}:Unearth.DESCRIPTION: If you are in ${modID}:Burnout, put a card from your discard pile into your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

${modID}:Haunted.NAME: Haunted
${modID}:Haunted.DESCRIPTION: The next !M! cards you play are played twice. NL Then, ${modID}:Burnout.

${modID}:Apotheosis.NAME: Apotheosis
${modID}:Apotheosis.DESCRIPTION: Upgrade ALL of your cards for the rest of combat. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:BulletTime.NAME: Bullet Time
${modID}:BulletTime.DESCRIPTION: You cannot draw any more cards this turn. NL Reduce the cost of all cards in your hand to 0 this turn. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:PatchUp.NAME: Patch Up
${modID}:PatchUp.DESCRIPTION: Turn a non-Burn card in your hand into a Burn. NL Attack: deal !D! damage to a random enemy. NL Skill: gain !B! Block. NL Power: draw !M! cards. NL Curse or Status: apply 1 Vulnerable and 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose a card to turn into a Burn.

${modID}:ExhumeTwo.NAME: Exhume Two
${modID}:ExhumeTwo.DESCRIPTION: Put !M! cards from your exhaust pile into your hand. They cost 0 for the rest of combat. NL Exhaust.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose cards to put into your hand.

${modID}:AbyssalPeering.NAME: Abyssal Peering
${modID}:AbyssalPeering.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards. NL If any of them are ${modID}:Chant cards, ${modID}:Chant.

${modID}:RitualDefend.NAME: Ritual Defend
${modID}:RitualDefend.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL Apply !M! Weak. NL ${modID}:Chant.

${modID}:RitualJammaSlamma.NAME: Ritual Jamma Slamma
${modID}:RitualJammaSlamma.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Costs 1 less for each ${modID}:Chant completed this combat.

${modID}:SturdyBody.NAME: Sturdy Body
${modID}:SturdyBody.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL If your ${modID}:Heat is below half of your Max HP, gain !M! more.

${modID}:CalmingSage.NAME: Calming Sage
${modID}:CalmingSage.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL Apply !M! Weak to ALL enemies.

${modID}:ExpungeFire.NAME: Expunge Fire
${modID}:ExpungeFire.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy. NL Deal !M! damage to ALL enemies. NL Lose 10 ${modID}:Heat.

${modID}:RitualBlast.NAME: Ritual Blast
${modID}:RitualBlast.DESCRIPTION: ${modID}:Chant !M! times. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:RitualMultihit.NAME: Ritual Multihit
${modID}:RitualMultihit.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Hits an additional time for each ${modID}:Chant completed this combat.

${modID}:Chant.NAME: Chant
${modID}:Chant.DESCRIPTION: ${modID}:Chant. NL If you have completed a ${modID}:Chant this turn, ${modID}:Chant !M! times instead.

${modID}:RitualSlash.NAME: Ritual Slash
${modID}:RitualSlash.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL ${modID}:Chant once for each unblocked damage dealt. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:TheWorldAflame.NAME: The World Aflame
${modID}:TheWorldAflame.DESCRIPTION: Double all ${modID}:Heat you gain. NL Whenever you ${modID}:Overheat, do not ${modID}:Burnout.
